_what: Seal v1 is retired: an embedded sign: block signs only the body, a v1 .bonsaisig only the bytes, and neither signs its own metadata. While v1 is "warn", a v1 seal that holds is accepted and reported as retired-v1 with a warning. Once it is "refuse", every v1 seal is refused everywhere.
_flip: Set v1 to "refuse" when the v2 re-seal batch is done AND the v2 /verify is deployed at bon-sai.garden. The gardener rules the flip; this one line is the switch, read by lib/seal-v2.mjs and by bonsai-garden tools/sign.py. It is never an environment variable. A missing or unreadable file reads as refuse.
_what-sidecar-name: The sidecar of X is .X.bonsaisig, hidden, beside its file. While sidecar-name is "warn", a seal found at the old name X.bonsaisig that holds is accepted and reported as retired-sidecar-name with a warning naming the fix: git mv X.bonsaisig .X.bonsaisig, or re-seal (the writers move it). Once it is "refuse", every old-name seal is refused as retired-sidecar-name, whatever its bytes, with the same fix.
_flip-sidecar-name: Set sidecar-name to "refuse" when the tracked old-name count is 0 in all six repos (core, runtime, mono, pot, site, archive). The gardener rules the flip; this one line is the switch, read by lib/verify.mjs through lib/seal-v2.mjs and by bonsai-garden tools/sign.py. It is never an environment variable. A missing or unreadable file, or a missing key, reads as refuse.
_what-custody-fallback: A seal may declare the custody tier its signer's master salt rested on (field custody: hardware | os-protected | vault-cli | software-fallback; spec-gardeners-keys §10). While custody-fallback is "refuse" (the default; a missing key reads refuse), a seal that declares software-fallback is refused as custody-refused even when it holds, because for a stranger the fallback is below the floor (the Aruji, 2026-10-06). Set it to "warn" only for the lab preview, where the fallback is allowed, named; a worse finding (hash-mismatch, bad-signature) always stands over this one.
_flip-custody-fallback: The gardener rules the flip, in either direction, one line here, read by lib/verify.mjs and by bonsai-garden tools/sign.py; never an environment variable. When the lab preview ends, set it back to "refuse".
